checks.name: Backend verify incl. IdentityIntegrationTest (real Keycloak + PostgreSQL) and StaffAssuranceTest
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and client tests
Local stack verify incl. PKCE refusal, anonymous 401 and full web OIDC login through the API

scenarios.observed: IdentityIntegrationTest: anonymous GET /api/v1/me returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED without profile fields and without a login redirect; a suspended account's valid token returns 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED with no profile data; public GET routes are not behind authentication. ApiErrorIntegrationTest: unknown private routes return 401 before revealing existence.

Web: with a valid session cookie, PATCH /api/v1/me and POST /api/v1/auth/logout without the X-XSRF-TOKEN header return 403 and the database/session are unchanged; with the token they succeed. Native: Keycloak refuses authorization for matbakhy-mobile without code_challenge (error=invalid_request, no code), refuses an unregistered redirect_uri (400, no redirect), and a code exchange with the wrong PKCE verifier fails with invalid_grant; the backend web client also sends a PKCE challenge. The native client has no secret (public client).

Real web OIDC login creates a PostgreSQL-backed session; idle-expired session returns 401; logout deletes only that session row (old cookie then 401) while a second session of the same user still works; bearer tokens for another client's audience, tampered payloads, self-signed tokens with an admin role claim, malformed tokens and expired tokens (clock advanced 1 h) return 401; a provider-asserted realm admin role grants no staff permission (403 FORBIDDEN); staff step-up probe without MFA returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED; one local account per (issuer, subject); CORS preflight from an unlisted origin is 403. Local stack smoke completes a full web login through the API container.

findings: Defects found and repaired during the story: component scan did not include module packages; Keycloak realm import file naming; test cookie jar dropped Secure cookies on localhost; synthetic last names failed Keycloak person-name validation; idle-expiry test initially edited the cleanup column instead of last access time; local realm note contained an unresolved ${...} placeholder; rendered realm file unreadable by the non-root Keycloak user.

Existing tests adjusted to new security semantics, not weakened: /actuator/env is now denied before routing (asserted denied with no environment data leaked); migration test now expects V1 and V2; error-handling probes run under a test-only permit-all chain for their probe paths only.

Residual: logout response gives the SPA its own ID token as id_token_hint (standard OIDC RP logout; ID token is not an API credential). Provider endpoint layout assumes Keycloak (O07 open). Staff grants, audit and object scopes are MB-011. Native on-device token handling is P07.
Positive staff MFA path is unit-tested with synthetic claims; a real MFA login was not automated in this story.
